name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Holy smokes.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
When I first ran for Congress I never would have expected that Arizona would become one of the most important swing states in the country. Arizona was a solid lock for the GOP back then, but we’ve made incredible progress over the last few years.
#

Hey Peter, I just got off the stage at our rally in Arizona.
I’ve gotta tell you, that was like nothing I’ve ever seen before.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240809-3-90&t=1&akid=2835%2E734936%2EujfpMT)
When I first ran for Congress I never would have expected that Arizona would become one of the most important swing states in the country. Arizona was a solid lock for the GOP back then, but we’ve made incredible progress over the last few years.
Think about it:
In 2020, we defeated Trump in Arizona and elected Senator Mark Kelly.
In 2022, we won Mark a full term and defeated Kari Lake and a whole mess of MAGA-right candidates.
In 2024, we’re going to do it again. Arizona’s congressional races are going to determine whether we take back the House. Whether we win or lose this race against Kari Lake will determine control of the Senate. And we’ve got to defeat Trump here if we’re going to defend the White House.
But the truth is, we’re running out of time. There are less than 90 days between now and Election Day, and we need to make the most of every single one.
[**Please, make a donation of any amount tonight and help me raise the resources we need to win in Arizona this year. Can’t do this without you, Peter.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240809-3-90&t=2&akid=2835%2E734936%2EujfpMT)

Monroe County Republicans were quite active and visible at the Monroe County Fair. They also sponsored hole #5 at the Sparta Chamber of Commerce Golf Outing. Monroe County handed out plenty of campaign signs and reminded all golfers to vote YES for both ballot referendums on AUG 13. **Winnebago County**
The Republican Party of Winnebago County was at a fair last weekend in Oshkosh. **St. Croix County**
The Republican Party of St. Croix County had Poll Worker and Poll Observer training with special guests Mike Hoffman, Annette Olson, and Senator Rob Stafsholt. They also held their quarterly membership and Executive Board Meeting. **Waukesha County**
The Republican Party of Waukesha County was part of Dousman Derby Daze Parade. They handed out mini-America flags, flag motif wrapped tootsie rolls, and county party literature. It was great to get a standing ovation from start to finish. **Wood County**
The Republican Party of Wood County held a membership meeting and collected goods for Mary's Place located in Wisconsin Rapids. Some large signs went up and they are thankful for the Wisconsin Rapids Police Officers in Milwaukee at the RNC, pictured with Pete Church, Adams County Chairman. **Kenosha County**
The Republican Party of Kenosha County had their Annual Red Witch II sailboat cruise and their mid year member meeting where they gave out Campbell Awards and recognized Kenosha County RNC volunteers with a thank you token. Kenosha County also had a Super Saturday and tabled at Templo La Hermosa Festival. **Washington County**
The Republican Party of Washington County went door knocking with the Young Republicans and made referendum signs. **Douglas County**
The Republican Party of Douglas County has opened an office. They have had three events: Billings Park Days and two meet and greets. More than 1,600 abortions occur every day._ But when a mother facing an unplanned pregnancy receives a free ultrasound session from PreBorn! -- when she sees her baby's tiny hands and feet and hears her baby's heartbeat -- by God's grace, everything changes. When she sees her baby on an ultrasound, she will choose life (instead of abortion) 80% of the time. Without an ultrasound, one out of every three preborn babies will tragically perish. **[Friend, will you make a gift of $28 today so that PreBorn! can provide ONE MORE free ultrasound session to a young mom at a crossroads?](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjIzLWNiMmYzNjg1MTJkMzQxNDQ5MzA1ZjE0MTI0MzdjZjBkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwNDI0RU05In0/0VOyeAuG8ryBE0Lq_Tt-TA)**

Our Christ-centered, church-based, and integrity-focused ministry was started to help save lives created in God's image - and to give young moms the opportunity to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ, _perhaps for the first time in their lives_. **[Your gift of $28 will provide a free ultrasound for one mother -- $56 will reach two mothers in need -- $128 will reach five mothers -- and rescue their children from abortion.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjIzLWNiMmYzNjg1MTJkMzQxNDQ5MzA1ZjE0MTI0MzdjZjBkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjUiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwNDI0RU05In0/gqj7cs5VGI3bu5KG_s639w)**

[Sponsor a life-saving ultrasound!](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjIzLWNiMmYzNjg1MTJkMzQxNDQ5MzA1ZjE0MTI0MzdjZjBkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjYiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwNDI0RU05In0/NQDPT9BQ9nn0V7VlNTQaFA)

Facing extreme pressure from her boyfriend, she sought an abortion in her home state of Ohio ... but she was turned away due to the state's new legislation. Lauren's boyfriend put her on a plane to Washington, D.C. to send her to the largest abortion clinic in the region. But on her way to the abortion clinic, Lauren got lost - and when she walked into the doors of the PreBorn! Network Clinic, she was embraced with compassion and love like she had never known. **_Lauren saw her preborn baby thanks to a free ultrasound and heard the steady "whoosh" of her little one's beating heart. Lauren heard the Gospel, opened her heart to Jesus' abundant grace and love ... and she chose life!_** Friend, every day we hear more stories like this. We praise God for His intervention on behalf of these women and their children. To Him alone be the Glory! **[To help more women see their preborn babies on an ultrasound and choose life, please support PreBorn! with your gift of $28 or more today.](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjIzLWNiMmYzNjg1MTJkMzQxNDQ5MzA1ZjE0MTI0MzdjZjBkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjciLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3ByZWJvcm4uYmFieS9BRUwwNDI0RU05In0/l0cNf1QYh0A5pnup1Ki9VQ)**

Our Christ-centered, church-based, and integrity-focused ministry was started to help save lives created in God's image - and to give young moms the opportunity to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ, perhaps for the first time in their lives. While the abortion debate rages in state legislatures and courtrooms, PreBorn! has taken a different approach: leading the nation in empowering women facing unplanned pregnancies by offering compassionate, Christ-centered care. Please let me tell you the story of just one young woman that PreBorn! has reached. Lauren was terrified when she discovered her unplanned pregnancy. Facing extreme pressure from her boyfriend, she sought an abortion in her home state of Ohio ... but she was turned away due to the state's new legislation. Lauren's boyfriend put her on a plane to Washington, D.C. to send her to the largest abortion clinic in the region. But on her way to the abortion clinic, Lauren got lost - and when she walked into the doors of the PreBorn! Network Clinic, she was embraced with compassion and love like she had never known. Lauren saw her preborn baby thanks to a free ultrasound and heard the steady "whoosh" of her little one's beating heart. Lauren heard the Gospel, opened her heart to Jesus' abundant grace and love ... and she chose life! Friend, every day we hear more stories like this. We praise God for His intervention on behalf of these women and their children. To Him alone be the Glory! With the support of our pro-life friends like you, Friend, we can continue saving babies ... and saving souls ... by the power of the Gospel! Please join us in praying that the Lord will bless our efforts this coming year, trusting and believing that He will help us accomplish the goals He has placed on our hearts for 2024. Choosing life, Dan Steiner PreBorn! body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvnr1g7pfj0qffsjm59690bt1pljk348q51bj8n0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhnitnah9i7h5jjr93hk79emqb4ub363a8ptkifg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zo1pu4ka2umjjsjfd517pmlgvqlmt6nq7tudu260_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zt3irjmbh41qpf5vjtplg4fdgm7phrfcdiqg2nlo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr2b9qs1v51nmh7infbmdcvr0sgpulh4e6kbv290_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziq684ccfsu1u492qu63pm1dprgvfbq88vtqko00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9gecp32cth2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,

name: JD Vance
subject: United States Marine Corps
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trump National Committee JFC Inc
body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zphhs3hghi30g1dpc6vild128kpih2gj4itrisgg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zus28euc6unvjam99g3uvdo11recn4l32725t9qo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zqg4mslrat5lsa2a9h592qgh68vt6rqt86hl9lig_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zjeb8csjtf2pjqn0cfcbamt3eemf3uk4sedm8kso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zhch70cfpajn0odrsahto4cijfnlgk86fi7mk33g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z78krl13926nicgr2437s1eijksfa1jqb2483neo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zhrbvdm3cn556b8h4ekds1pb78v2opp2ss9r4v1o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9geao72cjh2bs)

JD Vance Future Vice President of the United States
PS: If you can’t afford to donate because Kamala Harris has wrecked our economy, please save your donation for another time. I only ask that you please say a prayer for everyone currently serving in harm’s way.

| It's time to go on the offense against the Democrats and their selected-not-elected candidate, Kamala Harris. She was the least popular 2020 Democrat presidential candidate, is an unpopular Vice President, and didn't run for the nomination this year. Yet, she has been installed at the top of their ticket for 2024, and on August 22nd, at the Democrat's national convention, she will give her nomination acceptance speech. All of this after Democrat Party leadership refused to hold a legitimate primary and ultimately forced Joe Biden out of the race when they could no longer conceal his mental decline.
**That is why the Tea Party Patriot Citizens Fund will hold a**[**National Day of Action**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a417b22e/1edb9794a4173cf2)**on August 22 nd to Get Out The Vote for Donald Trump.** **
** We need you to connect with Trump supporters and make sure they have a plan to vote while the selected-not-elected, radically left-wing candidate makes her speech to a room full of people who didn't even vote for her to be the presidential nominee, but who don't care because they're relieved that Joe Biden was removed from the ticket.
You can choose to phone bank from home or write and mail postcards for the National Day of Action. If you opt for the postcard option, we will send you postcards and provide you with sample messages you can write on the postcards. Once you've written your message and signed them, purchase stamps and affix them to the postcards. When ready, simply drop them in the mail. **Please keep in mind that stamps are $0.73 each, so consider this cost when requesting postcards.****
** Note: After writing your message on the postcards, please send photos! Your photos help us recruit other volunteers and every volunteer we recruit results in more Trump voters actually voting. You can text the photos to 470-413-6995.
Whichever method of action you choose--phone or postcard--we will contact you after you sign up with more information.
**Thank you for your dedication to save our republic. We could _not_ do this without each and every one of you.**

name: JD Vance
subject: United States Marine Corps
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trump National Committee JFC Inc
body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8vm9rs4uhlkki8atr056vqhodtimmehs8i04fd0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ge9ob6cth2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z699hrnp8rshbih954391vmfmm8ne1o2cblskumo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ge9ob6cth2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.

body:
I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well.

| | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsv03sm3orl4u6us3jp1kqo28nnf0maok4hm38po_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our “leaders” in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn’t know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb718i5j09u4k0mv77u9iirf66j32i9qrml373uo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)
Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable.
I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I’m proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn’t like you’d see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.
**_That’s what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs._**
President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we’re going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support.
**_[Kamala Harris is raising millions, so today, I’m humbly asking you to chip in just $5 to get President Trump back in the White House.>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zretvs5514tiev3jqg946eht0nn4dtf06fj0rl6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znrd3dh0tataunofj8v2fkk9tk1qb1alfug9clsg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)
My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part.
I won’t run from the biggest fights we face as a nation.
If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST.
**_[Please show your support today. I promise that President Trump& I will never stop fighting for YOU.>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp4upficgeuceha14c8brn7qgiaegkrb2m7hulr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)_**

[DONATE TODAY](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4mks7f6kstk0voou7ot6bkuj8qhqdlagu35vg30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)
Thank you and may God bless you,
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkjd487hrdv7ecu9hg1f6lp4ff5slda4jcno5te8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj6c9ie8oj3c9h2bs)

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I hope
you're having a great day. There's something important I want to
share with you today.

For
years, we've seen a growing effort from radical activists to
destroy the principles of liberty that have made our nation the
freest and most prosperous in history. These radicals have found
a willing ally in the Biden administration's education
department.

And right
now-with the help of these government bureaucrats-they are
actively denigrating the U.S. Constitution in America's schools
while teaching destructive ideologies like critical race theory
and socialism.

We are at
a key point in our history. We must defend our nation's founding
documents and principles of liberty through education.

And
that's why I'm emailing you today.

Hillsdale
College recently produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our
very popular "Constitution 101" online course, and I'd like you
to have a copy.

The
course features Hillsdale's faculty-the same professors who teach
our required course on the Constitution on campus. And when you
view "Constitution 101," you'll learn about:

The
original design and purpose of the Constitution.
The
challenges it faced during the Civil War.
How
it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and
liberalism.
How
limited government under the Constitution might be revived in our
own time.

Right
now, it can be yours when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100
or more. You can take advantage of this limited-time offer using
this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63457681:s69tHGWZN:m:3:2532013465:C18994841BE9D44F151049A8A9B8B2F8:r

And when
you do, you'll not only get your own DVD box set, but you'll help
expand our national educational outreach efforts such as free
online courses, classical K-12 education curriculums, and
Imprimis-our digest of liberty.

We need
your support because we REFUSE all government funding, even
indirectly in the form of student grants or loans.

So,
please reserve your DVD box set with a gift of $100 or more using
this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63457681:s69tHGWZN:m:3:2532013465:C18994841BE9D44F151049A8A9B8B2F8:r

And
remember, as I mentioned above, supplies are limited, so be sure
to reserve your copy today.

Warm
regards,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President

Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale
College

## Debby Continues to Produce Severe Weather
The remnants of Hurricane Debby [continued to produce severe weather](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvpCAURn8Ndhq4oDAFxTZ0s-2W5ioXZYNikBnjv3-Zl7zuNV_1Jefk_HuOT4wp7stf3MjWkEeca3zTaFrBW1CjarwNRECyISs0SHgMvYZmtYh-RjmEhzKSCGcjUEyeTz6YXqkATbTAQXEjuOC87_tOBwPeI9EkaUCtmOLkY82l-5_jXlcK6c5vKt2ctybZtdbjZPIPA8fAXdfVvU6s2eP9OTBwZ83lZuCWgsca55OB-xAZOG5-Zn2VEmfcqfU0TXd7YF3bkHL2cV_agnFvNzwYOK20eCguOdcMXFOsP66YUjwHzRRfNozp26v-Xult4SsAAP__mGdoZA) in parts of the mid-Atlantic and Northeast on Friday, causing flooding, flight delays, and widespread power outages. Since making landfall in Florida on Monday as a [Category 1 hurricane](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOszAQhJ_GdI7MYmKncPE3dPnbK9GCF9gL2JHZA-XtT7lrr50ZaT59H_f-jrxymv_jRkGm3OMofFDvdW002N5WMUxEQE1FoXbQwO3aOqiWEMFO0GDjo_fOOYwjTr4e_HtgbH2rOIABa3xtamPatr24yUOMSDQ0dEVnlTUUWXK5fGZOstC0vvJB5TLmrVrDIvLcVfNPQaegOwll-e0UdLvksu0KuuWrFB4xkYIu0fmO3q_aeG1uWgqOD06zjjQML83bE0fZ9cFl5sSoE536lctDH1S2nKQqIT5PXlfer05ZM2_I6w-O_C3nCPAdAAD__6FrZ8g), Debby has been linked to eight deaths and a string of rare tropical tornadoes, producing winds as high as 140 mph. Heavy rains in the New York and Pennsylvania area produced [flash flooding](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH-NvRHB48seGLpkS9eOFh-P-FXYWJgmyr-v0rnj6ZbTfd2Wm6dC-_3Tb-h6rouPnR64TExwBmpRY3IZEVCO6IQFCbPRFsbV4aQ9N1KJeQ5SZSt4NtmIrC1PPkw4kgMOik-CC8611hebJ0jJIwaJxls1KI6Jem2X70p7XzGXV31gu8S6jcWtvR_nID8GuA5w9ceOz_Ot3tA6xYIDXNef1ij6HVlv9aDoCzt7bRtLGMKL5VJrov3OJI9oQegkRTBaZJWDthrnlFAnI3FsLh1PKoVOYwfF75un8hfS_9_ycPAbAAD__1ZEZKo), trapping people in their cars and homes. Floodwaters made multiple roads impassable, forcing first responders to attempt high-water and helicopter rescues. More than 35 million people [from South Carolina to Vermont](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuO5CAQheGnwRkWYHwLCDZx1ptuaBVQGFYYWrimrX77UU882ZG-5Oj_99gfkHIqx1840VCoOzhKL9wXLgVXetedNwFR4dChkbMa1DqNs-qimfQ6BBfcMHkrFgm4CulGGbTF2WqJXTJKKC0WKaQQ4zj2c1iU94BoB5xg1kwL9Ilq6__XVChiyO_6wta7enbZRKLnxYY_TG1Mbfd998W6gvf1caa2z_wAAkVsTG0X1XZyj9a-eUzES20UES7i8etA3iCVADnzkGv1qRycaivgK168uQJyGlepu2b88045p2uamRbHCSn_PKLf-7yM-g4AAP__QYlquA) were under flood watches on Friday.
## Delta Threatens Lawsuit Over Outage
Delta threatened [legal action against](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvhSAUhX8NbJjLFZQ3MHRxe107Gh5clBblRam2_76xSbcuJyc5yfmS7-0-3l3KaZ1e3UK2xjI6X9NBoxESBKpR8WAjEVLLycoeW7x1ukc-207rm_YSDD6UipFIRRW0JDSKoPWOJ4uACowECaC1bvpoMARH9Gipc71iCiikWrbmvaS1zhTzdzloa3xZeLZzrc-dtS8MB4bDeZ6N-0plv1aGw_XNcADzF4FydcJv5Qx73dIHifJZ3UTCl70KrUEsKedUVr7Z8Dyvvnc9UzAtLuVfZv3fwGHxJwAA__-wb1zR) both CrowdStrike and Microsoft on Thursday after a regulatory filing showed that July's internet outage cost the airline $550 million. The outage was linked to a[ cybersecurity update](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL8GOixYY7ALitfQ3WtTWhys7U3wccLETv4-utSpR5qR5u023wJleqz_w46uLWUOsdGJ8yiUFKBnzZNbEAF7jk5Z6GEygwW-OT3dlQSAUS062kkrGJSJJhrUOOmx5-RAgpajkkrKYRg6u4yQUkC892iC1UxLTNRK7d4LPdqGS_4uJ9Yulp1nt7X2PFj_j4Fn4K_r6sIXleNFGfiXm4GXloFXEwO_5nIPWTSMmyifLawoYi1XOlqlDxS0P0NsIlDN9MCDV5eeF-VMh7FMy3UPlH_D7e8Np4OfAAAA___vv15_) pushed out by CrowdStirke that affected Microsoft products. The defect resulted in flight cancellations and delays, television stations going dark, and banks unable to process transactions. CrowdStrike described Delta's narrative of events as "[misleading](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEbLgoErXPwN3f1tSrTYCzgx-IT3QPf20UVKl2aKmWI-fR_38U4hhn35TxtbmdNITsLJY68r0NiMTeHtzIxcF2yrDmu8tabDYrUduJYMkJ9v1FYzGWhpqk1fYY0OcCqCRcAG-goqAGNM2c09ek_MU80tdY1qgH2QdJSfKeyy8hxf6eSjdGkrol1FHlnV_xQOCofrukq3T-49KhzO4DkpHN4XCgfof8NzFNKZXll72mjhrB09M3s9vbQ70uWzHOGLdXoKLawlCUVNoiNTFm0A9BZiDGkvV9licVj_uN5FbjvVwLJRiD-A8reu0-J3AAAA__-re20B)" and stated that it had teams working with Delta to correct the problem. CrowdStrike even claimed they won praise from one Delta board member for their efforts. Delta also has legal worries of its own. Passengers whose flights were affected by the CrowdStrike tech outage last month filed a [lawsuit against the airline](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd1h4DDYuKF7jLq_d0prAELNLTGQmQfv3q2y93ZVucY7Ox2W7YMrpuP3HOzmOZUPP6UWblYOSoDfdBReJgMaO3DDDCMtkZuh2Z42OFCbrzRL1EmIcLGowCxo_q9FQlxwo0MoOalDKGNPP0UIISHQdacJZC60oJC5n_1nSwTvF_F1edPa-3LvsduZHFeM_AauAtbXW-2s9qNX3L2B9TwFroMwofcZa5Vu-HDJjq8_E0p-lhcpn-iLJ5HdZnow3ErB2pwuPlnJOdZqFVrc7pvzL5b8rvBz8BAAA__-Nh2Fr) this week.
## What to Stream This Weekend
The summer movie season may be winding down, but the number of quality films and television shows to stream has not slowed. Hulu has [_Brats_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszz1uwyAUAODTwBYLHn_2wFCp8uZI6dCOFjaPmBaHCGOnuX2lzrnAJ31fwzi4mOLtenYr2hry6OYaDxzbE2cnkKOk3gZEQEHRcgMCOq0M0MWyrnXKABqvtZ5CN0-Md1xIhV6YedY0WmAgWcsZZ0wp1ZjQgvcOcRKonZFEMvSx5tJ853irC4b0zAeWZs4rTXap9b4R8UagJ9A_8173ZkIC_fD7eb78fAzq8iCiD-jqXpCI921xBT0t1t8fMaW4aUMku64upn-yvg4eFv4CAAD__5CeUko) _,_ an excellent documentary by Andrew McCarthy that examines the Brat Pack, the group of teen actors who took over Hollywood in the 1980s. Emilio Estevez, Jon Cryer, Lea Thompson, Ally Sheedy, and Demi Moore appear, but it's Rob Lowe's interview that really puts everything into perspective. Apple TV's latest movie, [_The Instigators_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz0FuhCAUANDTwG4MfkBkwaJJ487umnZnGPiOv8HBItrO7Zt0PRd4yfsYp9FTovvtza_o6pwnHyqdOPWXVlxATYpHNyMCSo6uNSDBdtoAX5xswQcQnYGgO2OtMcGqoCV4G6OwkpMDAUr0rWiF0Fo3Zu4hRo94ldh5o5gSGKnm0nxlutcF5_TIJ5Ym5JUnt9S67Uy-MBgYDI981KO5IoPhU-fv7ZfkuxmZHGb09SjI5Ou--IKRFxe3H0qJ9s4wJW6rp_RP1ufB08FfAAAA__8oIFHA), pairs Matt Damon and Casey Affleck in a comedy-heist film, proving that Damon is at his best when working with an Affleck. The recent death of Bob Newhart had many in _The Flyover_ office feeling nostalgic, which is why we recommend [_Newhart_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GOhCAQgOGngW7NMKJiQXGN3V57pUEZFjYoG52V3Ntf7urr__zJ93Wf7y7ltD8-3UaWQ5ndyumi2dwU3FDPWnobiJBaSVYN2OLYdwPKaNegEEccwYwUFrP6JZjR9yG0PajOO5ksAmowChRA13XNEAx674iWlno3aKGBfOJyNM-Sdo4U8ne56GjWsslsI_PrFO2HwEngVGttnu-Tq-M1_hYCp_cpcOLrdsZSBU471egOlof1r5pyTmc_CA2PzaX89-T_hZfFnwAAAP__mFBUFQ) on Amazon Prime. All the seasons and Larry, his brother Darryl, and his other brother Darryl can be found there.

Check out their solutions to back pain! | Debby Continues to Produce Severe Weather The remnants of Hurricane Debby in parts of the mid-Atlantic and Northeast on Friday, causing flooding, flight delays, and widespread power outages. Since making landfall in Florida on Monday as a , Debby has been linked to eight deaths and a string of rare tropical tornadoes, producing winds as high as 140 mph. Heavy rains in the New York and Pennsylvania area produced , trapping people in their cars and homes. Floodwaters made multiple roads impassable, forcing first responders to attempt high-water and helicopter rescues. More than 35 million people were under flood watches on Friday. Delta Threatens Lawsuit Over Outage Delta threatened both CrowdStrike and Microsoft on Thursday after a regulatory filing showed that July's internet outage cost the airline $550 million. The outage was linked to a pushed out by CrowdStirke that affected Microsoft products. The defect resulted in flight cancellations and delays, television stations going dark, and banks unable to process transactions. CrowdStrike described Delta's narrative of events as "" and stated that it had teams working with Delta to correct the problem. CrowdStrike even claimed they won praise from one Delta board member for their efforts. Delta also has legal worries of its own. Passengers whose flights were affected by the CrowdStrike tech outage last month filed a this week. What to Stream This Weekend The summer movie season may be winding down, but the number of quality films and television shows to stream has not slowed. Hulu has , an excellent documentary by Andrew McCarthy that examines the Brat Pack, the group of teen actors who took over Hollywood in the 1980s. In her speech introducing Governor Walz, Vice President Harris said: _“Since the day that I announced my candidacy, I set out to find a partner who can help build [a] brighter future; a leader who will help unite our nation and move us forward; a fighter for the middle class; a patriot who believes, as I do, in the extraordinary promise of America -- a promise of freedom, opportunity and justice. It’s official – Minnesota Governor Tim Walz is our vice presidential candidate!
A beloved schoolteacher.
A championship-winning football coach.
A decorated veteran.
A respected congressman.
An accomplished governor.
**And your next vice president of the United States.**
Governor Walz was born in West Point, Nebraska and lived in Butte, a small town of 400 where community was a way of life. Growing up, he spent summers working on the family farm.
In Congress, he forged compromises and took action for vets.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Judges, Britain and the breakdown of an orderly society
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/educationstandards-11572932?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **Elections are underway for the Mississippi Supreme Court. **Five candidates are competing for a seat in the Central District, some of whom I heard speak at the Neshoba county fair recently. There’s a similar election taking place in south Mississippi.

**It’s easy to take it for granted that ordinary people are able to elect judges in our state.**
---
|
---
_Should judges be elected?_
| Judges have to decide complex legal questions dispassionately. **It is their job to determine what the law says, not what anyone – including judges – might want it to say.** At the same time, judges often seem to have a decisive say in determining important matters of public policy.

This sometimes encourages commentators to ask if we should allow ordinary voters to elect judges in the first place.

**“Do voters know enough to elect Mississippi judges?” ran one headline last week.** Given all the complexities and the fact that most voters have only a limited understanding of the law, surely it should be left to experts to decide who is best qualified to sit on the Mississippi Supreme Court?

**If you want to know why ordinary people in Mississippi ought to retain the power to elect their judges, look across the Atlantic. **On a brief visit to my native Britain, I was appalled at what’s been going on.

**There have been widespread riots in towns and cities across England over the past couple of weeks following the murder of three young girls in Southport at a Taylor Swift dance class. **
---
|
---
_Widespread riots and disorder in England_
| **The UK authorities are now alarmed that a sizeable number of Brits are extremely agitated about mass (often illegal) immigration.** Tens of thousands of illegal migrants have been allowed to flood into the country on small dinghies from France. 1 in 27 people now living in Britain arrived in the past two years. 4 in 10 foreign-born people in Britain have arrived in the past decade.

**More ominously, perhaps, millions of Brits seem to have lost confidence in what many see as a “two tier” criminal justice system.** There’s a widespread sense that the police and the judiciary in Britain routinely apply different standards to different groups, including Muslims.

When, for example, (non-Muslim) Roma immigrants rioted in the city of Leeds last month, the police seemed to stand back. A mere handful have been charged.

Contrast that to the way police this week arrested and charged people for saying obnoxious things online. **In Cheshire, the police arrested a woman for an inaccurate social media post. **
---
|
---
_Clown constabulary?_
| **The man in charge of public prosecutions in Britain moved into threatening mode, saying he has a team of “dedicated police officers scouring social media” to arrest people for posting things that are “insulting” or “abusive”.** He even threatened to extradite people to the UK for sharing such material online.

Unable to police the streets against violent robbery, the clowns running Britain today are arresting people for being rude online. Having failed to keep illegal immigrants out, they are threatening to import foreigners into the country against their will for what they re-tweet.

**How did Britain end up in such a sorry state? To a large extent it is a story about the corruption of Britain’s judiciary.**

**Mass immigration has become an explosive issue in Britain because judges have routinely thwarted attempts by successive governments to control it.** In 2010, 2015, 2017 and 2019 the British people voted overwhelmingly to cut immigration to less than 100,000 a year. This has not happened because judges have systematically prevented elected governments from controlling the country’s borders.

British judges only ever seem to rule in favor of those who enter the country illegally being able to remain. Their activism means judges rule on the basis of what they think the law should be, not the laws Parliament has passed.

**Britain, a once orderly, high-trust society, has become increasingly lawless because judges have routinely failed to apply sentences that ordinary Brits would regard as just. **It is so commonplace for violent robbers and rapists to be given community sentences, rather than go to prison, it is seldom even reported anymore. Only last month, it was announced that even violent offenders would be released from prison after serving 40 percent of their sentences.

**Why are British judges so awful? Because they are unaccountable to the public.**

In Britain, judges are appointed, not elected. Until 2006, at least the appointments were made by an elected minister, meaning there was at least some degree of democratic oversight.

Since 2006, Britain’s judges have been appointed by the Judicial Appointments Commission, a body obsessed about diversity, equity and inclusion, rather than justice. **Liberty and order in Britain are collapsing as a consequence. **

Back in Neshoba, it was refreshing to watch wannabe judges having to connect with the people that they wanted to serve. They talked of their record of service. They gave the audience a good sense of their values.

**Watching the process of judicial elections, I realise it would be impossible for Mississippi, with elected judges, to end up in the absurd situation Britain is now in.**

Keep it that way. Elect your judges to safeguard your liberties.

Bar some very exceptional circumstances, such as when a city descends into dysfunction (Jackson?), elected judges are better than the alternatives.
---
|
---
_Neshoba – common sense capital of America? _
| Have a great weekend!
---

clean_body: I’m a Marine Corps veteran, blue-city Republican mayor, husband and father running for Congress in California’s battleground 9th District. | Hi, fellow conservative, I just want to take a second to re-introduce myself. I’m a Marine Corps veteran, blue-city Republican mayor, husband and father running for Congress in California’s battleground 9th District. This is one of the top seats targeted to flip from blue to red in 2024, and it’s a vital part of our strategy to protect and expand our GOP House majority. That’s why Speaker Mike Johnson and House Republican leaders are backing my campaign. In our primary, more voters cast their ballot for a Republican than for my Democrat opponent, Josh Harder. Now, House Democrats have placed Harder in their most vulnerable category – they know they’re in trouble. We’re locked in a tight race, and every advantage is needed to pull ahead and flip this seat. Can I count on your support? Semper Fi, Kevin Lincoln Veteran, USMC GOP Nominee, CA-9 | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. Nella is a strong, principled, independent leader who will stand up for our values and work tirelessly to bring common-sense solutions to the Senate. Her commitment to border security, economic growth, and restoring American strength is exactly what New Mexico – and our country – needs right now.

The stakes are high, and the radical left is pouring a ton of resources to hold onto seats like this one in New Mexico. _**Newt Gingrich**_

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Her commitment to border security, economic growth, and restoring American strength is exactly what New Mexico – and our country – needs right now. The stakes are high, and the radical left is pouring a ton of resources to hold onto seats like this one in New Mexico. So please, let’s seize the moment and make history together. Thank you for standing with us in this critical fight. Warm regards, Newt Gingrich P.S. Time is running out, and every day counts in this razor-thin race. | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. Fellow patriot,

With Pres. Trump naming my good friend and Republican Senator from Ohio – JD Vance – as his VP running mate, **Democrats know that they’re in _even more_ danger now in Ohio.**

_So, naturally, they’re ramping up their attacks on me._

**Pres. Trump and JD Vance are counting on us making a full sweep in Ohio.** They know we need this seat to deliver a Republican Senate majority that will work with them to clean up Biden’s and Kamala’s mess.

If we can just close the fundraising gap with Sherrod Brown, then we can lock down this seat.

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

body:
Over the last few weeks, we’ve seen more energy and enthusiasm in politics than we’ve seen in a while.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90565706/490939316/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTY3YTUzZi0yMTU3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xs0cvSeobK0JNl4XUp0VnZNfFWqR_8zvvxYtpbZTH2o=&emci=f7cd3105-aa55-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=0167a53f-2157-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=26261389)

| | I'm incredibly optimistic about our future. Over the last few weeks, we've seen more energy and enthusiasm in politics than we've seen in a while. **It makes me hopeful for what's to come.** In the coming months, election season is going to start picking up. While some campaigns are focused on the past and running on a platform of hate, we're running a different kind of campaign, one that's focused on the future and joy. For me, joy is the motivating factor in all the work we do. Seeing the sigh of relief when we connect a veteran with resources about their well-deserved benefits, watching children go into a new school year knowing they're safe and their leaders are invested in their futures, and breathing in clean air with new investments in a greener tomorrow – these are the signs of joy that keep me going in this fight. Our campaign is fighting for a better future for New Jersey – one that brings everyone into the conversation and includes every voice in our democracy. I am in this race to restore integrity back into our politics, show people that there are public servants who are trying to do the right work, and put the people ahead of personal gain or ambition and just be able to deliver for my state. Since we launched our campaign, thousands of grassroots Democrats have jumped in to support our movement to return this seat to the people of New Jersey. Now more than ever, we need a campaign that runs on joy and hope for the future – and that's what we intend to be for the people of New Jersey. **New Jerseyans are ready for change.** We know this because of the energy we're seeing across the state. Over the last few weeks, we've seen more energy and enthusiasm in politics than we've seen in a while. It makes me hopeful for what's to come. In the coming months, election season is going to start picking up. While some campaigns are focused on the past and running on a platform of hate, we're running a different kind of campaign, one that's focused on the future and joy. For me, joy is the motivating factor in all the work we do. Seeing the sigh of relief when we connect a veteran with resources about their well-deserved benefits, watching children go into a new school year knowing they're safe and their leaders are invested in their futures, and breathing in clean air with new investments in a greener tomorrow – these are the signs of joy that keep me going in this fight. Our campaign is fighting for a better future for New Jersey – one that brings everyone into the conversation and includes every voice in our democracy. I am in this race to restore integrity back into our politics, show people that there are public servants who are trying to do the right work, and put the people ahead of personal gain or ambition and just be able to deliver for my state. Since we launched our campaign, thousands of grassroots Democrats have jumped in to support our movement to return this seat to the people of New Jersey. Now more than ever, we need a campaign that runs on joy and hope for the future – and that's what we intend to be for the people of New Jersey. New Jerseyans are ready for change. Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win in
November.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as

far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,

| | | Donald Trump held a press conference, and it proved one thing -- [he's losing his marbles](https://default.salsalabs.org/T116b5459-ef14-49e4-b4d4-c55ab7fb9e19/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). He spouted the usual lies which he's been doing for years. But he also made up a weird story about a helicopter crash that never happened. And he didn't know who the governor of California was. And he rambled, went off topic, and showed the classic signs of dementia. Something he's been doing more and more as of late. And yet, when you read or see a news report on Trump, there's hardly ever a straightforward statement that this guy is going nuts. Understandably, many are uncomfortable saying it straight out. But this guy could be back in the White House, and peple need to know how far gone he is *before* the election, not after. A lot of folks probably don’t know this, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back.

Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families.

She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service.

I often refer to her as _“my quintessential big sister,”_ because she has always shown up for me when I needed her.

In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her.

I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._

And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever.

Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent.

[_**Will you please split a $25 donation right now between my campaign and Sarah Elfreth to help me defeat Republican Larry Hogan so Kamala Harris has a Democratic Senate majority on Day 1?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/90574115/490957534/472092754?refcode=BLU_EM_SEFC_2024-08-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNWZhOGI5NC0yYTU3LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6zH1ADmhjkleeetle9D267V6F0pTMMsioA1DPzOARsw=)

Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear, overreach, and fewer rights?

Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a country and embrace progress?

In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question.

_Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be another rubber stamp for it in the Senate._

clean_body: A lot of folks probably don’t know this, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. | = A lot of folks probably don’t know this, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last. And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent. = | = | = This whole election cycle boils down to this: Will our country be dragged backwards, reverting back to an era of fear, overreach, and fewer rights? Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a country and embrace progress? In both Kamala Harris’ race and my own, that’s the fundamental question. Donald Trump IS the MAGA agenda, and Republican Larry Hogan would be another rubber stamp for it in the Senate. That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November, but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state has ever seen, so we’re going to need a lot of resources. | | | Friend, it's a well-known tradition for senators to carve their names in the drawers of their desks in the Senate – some of which have been around since the early 1800s. It's perhaps a bit less well-known that we also get to choose our desks when we first get elected. Even though they're all technically the same, this was a decision I took pretty seriously.
---
**When I saw the names on desk 88, I knew I had found my Senate home.** Robert F. Kennedy, Al Gore Sr., George McGovern, and more – the progressive senators who preceded me at this desk all fought to make our country a better, more equal place. They helped end segregation, protested the Vietnam War, and fought against wealth disparity. Their legacies inspire me to keep fighting for American families and the Dignity of Work.
**But the truth is, I'm now in urgent need of your help to keep up this fight.**

Our future progress hinges on defending our Democratic majority – which could all come down to my toss-up race in Ohio. The GOP knows this, which is why Mitch McConnell has named me a top target for defeat, and why GOP special interests are spending millions to flip this seat.
**I'm committed to continuing the righteous fights of those who sat at desk 88 before me – but I can't do so without your support. It’s official. I am the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate here in Michigan.
I’m so grateful to Michigan voters for entrusting me not only with this honor, but also the responsibility of keeping Michigan and this U.S. Senate seat blue in November. I will not let you down.
Because there is just too much at stake:
Whether Michigan is a place where anyone can get in and stay in the middle class.
Whether our granddaughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.
Whether the American experiment of a multi-racial, multi-ethnic democracy continues.
And whether Michigan contributes to keeping the White House, and making history.
So you can bet I will be working harder than I ever have before. I know that we can win this, but it will take all of us. My team has set a rather ambitious $100,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal for the next week so that we can hit the ground running in the sprint to the general election. Will you split a donation of $20 or more between Tim Kaine and my campaign tonight and become a General Election Founding Donor? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

He has co-sponsored bills that would not only ban abortion nationwide but threaten in-vitro fertilization and birth control. He supported privatizing Social Security and Medicare. After 20 years as a politician, Rogers left Michigan for good. He cashed in on his D.C. connections to make millions by helping Chinese tech companies, giving them access to the United States. And in doing so, increased his net worth by as much as 2,000%. Then he bought a mansion in Florida and two yachts. He is only moving back to Michigan to run for the Senate.
It’s clear: Mike Rogers is only looking out for himself.
I will be working to make sure every Michigan voter understands just how bad Mike Rogers would be for Michiganders if elected to the Senate, but we need resources to start immediately holding him accountable to his record.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=8081357947d54abbb9b6dc610e8b8cc5&_e=EaUUkbndI_B1aDexzD2Jgd8RjCpWrH4AO39O_gKg80cSZIWjZ3O6EcbxJ2br6xG7qIzJpMIrNspX1Oy7pEWUcov9gYTNfj9vV-uCyR6e3YwSZEfb0ulL78gzVuW3ByV2k1O0_A-Yl1zx0N4KGs7ZEfIRfGnyp_DujWTYxqN8uFtPsSxA4AlC4O58q37y6rzqQ8pxMMjBPUWRmHfyrFZKDsiihlRQKT39DGeIAsbFjMHSzfV0sbfL-6t-nR-lsdgpltq4u4Dg9BG5w5vA-CW5Wf6ZMgyGnIqLBuRIpWgLa5hh_dZDZRx46ccP22aXvnzUuQPloNs-aoG43UlU5ZUvDDts8xKmv5GFuyJ0tsoA9a0HE2dLMhCSQyAKstljQZUGWwmTbFGg0VXNqFO4V3Wum0yu0GpXwguHYSmSMMYC5Co%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

August 10, 2024
[Ed Dadakis](https://substack.com/redirect/3e34aa82-7a82-464c-b943-23b53f94cb5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a prominent Greenwich businessman and political figure has enthusiastically endorsed Dr. Michael Goldstein for Congress. Please vote in the August 13 primary.
Mr. Dadakis is a Justice of the Peace and Executive Vice President with Aon Risk Services in Stamford and New York City where he structures and develops comprehensive insurance and risk management programs for large corporate clients. He has served as a State Central Committee member for the Republican Party in Connecticut. His endorsement is below:

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a9f8c0f-a8ce-43d0-840d-4bbc3eb12f78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ed Dadakis
The dog days of summer are upon us and I hope you have been enjoying this time of year. I do want to remind you to make sure you vote in the Republican primary on Tuesday August 13th.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bc96528c-52fe-423d-8ff8-2c8a7418da3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Yes there is a Republican primary. Sometimes I feel it is one of the best kept secrets in town, but the candidates have been working hard. You have the opportunity on Tuesday to select the Republican candidate for both US Senate to oppose Chris Murphy and US House of Representatives to oppose Jim Himes.
I strongly recommend that you cast your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein as our candidate for the U.S. House. While it is without doubt an uphill battle to defeat Himes, if anyone can do it Michael can. He is a determined person and is both a physician and a lawyer. It takes a lot of discipline to do both. If elected he will bring common sense back to the House supporting individual freedoms and fiscal responsibility. And won't it be nice to have a Doctor in the House.
So please don't forget to vote in the Republican Primary Tuesday August 13th. Polls are open from 6am to 8pm. You can also avail yourself of early voting anytime between 10am and 6pm today (Friday) or Saturday or Sunday at Town Hall.

You have the opportunity on Tuesday to select the Republican candidate for both US Senate to oppose Chris Murphy and US House of Representatives to oppose Jim Himes. I strongly recommend that you cast your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein as our candidate for the U.S. House. While it is without doubt an uphill battle to defeat Himes, if anyone can do it Michael can. He is a determined person and is both a physician and a lawyer. It takes a lot of discipline to do both. If elected he will bring common sense back to the House supporting individual freedoms and fiscal responsibility. And won't it be nice to have a Doctor in the House. So please don't forget to vote in the Republican Primary Tuesday August 13th. Polls are open from 6am to 8pm. You can also avail yourself of early voting anytime between 10am and 6pm today (Friday) or Saturday or Sunday at Town Hall. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Joseph Bentivegna 541 Cromwell Avenue, Rocky Hill, CT 06067 ? ?

Hi team,
I’m Krutika, NextGen’s Digital Intern. I just graduated from college this May and couldn’t think of a better way to make a difference than by helping people my age protect our democracy.
But that’s only part of my story.
As an immigrant kid, I dreamed of the day I could cast my vote. In a country where democracy and fairness were extolled as virtues, I wanted nothing more than to make my voice heard. _And after seeing the results of the 2016 election, I realized just how much my voice matters._
The overturning of _Roe vs. Wade_ , extremists storming the Capitol, Donald Trump’s blatant disregard for the rule of law, and the increasing damage being done to our environment all showed me that the people we choose to lead us will make their mark on our lives, one way or another.
And as crazy as it was to see all these things happen in real time, it just strengthened my resolve to use my vote and my voice wisely.
Growing up, I was often told I was “too young to understand,” or that my generation was too sensitive and lazy. But that couldn’t be further from the truth.
The truth is, when so many of our rights are undermined and our democracy is under threat, it’s easy for my generation to feel hopeless.
**_But right now, I’ve never felt more powerful. I’ve never felt so much hope. And I’ve never been more excited to make a difference._**
[I’m not the only young voter who’s ready to take this election by storm. All over the country, people my age are getting more and more energized and excited to make a difference. NextGen is working nonstop to keep up this incredible momentum, but we need your help. clean_body: | Hi team, I’m Krutika, NextGen’s Digital Intern. I just graduated from college this May and couldn’t think of a better way to make a difference than by helping people my age protect our democracy. But that’s only part of my story. As an immigrant kid, I dreamed of the day I could cast my vote. In a country where democracy and fairness were extolled as virtues, I wanted nothing more than to make my voice heard. And after seeing the results of the 2016 election, I realized just how much my voice matters. The overturning of Roe vs. Wade , extremists storming the Capitol, Donald Trump’s blatant disregard for the rule of law, and the increasing damage being done to our environment all showed me that the people we choose to lead us will make their mark on our lives, one way or another. And as crazy as it was to see all these things happen in real time, it just strengthened my resolve to use my vote and my voice wisely. Growing up, I was often told I was “too young to understand,” or that my generation was too sensitive and lazy. But that couldn’t be further from the truth. The truth is, when so many of our rights are undermined and our democracy is under threat, it’s easy for my generation to feel hopeless. But right now, I’ve never felt more powerful. I’ve never felt so much hope. And I’ve never been more excited to make a difference. | | | | | | With gratitude, Patel Digital Intern NextGen PAC | Paid for by NextGen Climate Action Committee; ; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | = |

| | | | [](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=60a9065981054031988260721512e78c&_e=y1iL6GedETH6raeYNgsTjmnFI1T97LR3uj7Eo3X9CN4yknXY8E_XDLbgBBsQh4bkz37BBr2w6n1NbTypqg2tvK8QMpdUmLC1HLnRDmGGofK8T6XFF3pxfdaqlnOxrDctxWgPEVnh_6_MGL9MTKpSsnI1SRu4xWOK78Oci4DvnFLInHxk7zGGNVc29mElAby6slmyxySfccuFfsaWKClI625VAl6WoHhyB2NqbGUUc_aSrlxDzhHaFDG1YcvQtRfisTljMuW5-ps2NN1Ml_FH26-3imA1IJNn8hiIrphaXmv2IlCXuzOAVYFjXiwVh8Dm)

Friend, I just heard **_[Jamie Raskins plan to overturn the election if Trump wins](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=60a9065981054031988260721512e78c&_e=y1iL6GedETH6raeYNgsTjmnFI1T97LR3uj7Eo3X9CN4yknXY8E_XDLbgBBsQh4bkz37BBr2w6n1NbTypqg2tvK8QMpdUmLC1HLnRDmGGofK8T6XFF3pxfdaqlnOxrDctxWgPEVnh_6_MGL9MTKpSsnI1SRu4xWOK78Oci4DvnFLDH2lUdZHBufs8rf-dp_iaMopncbl_kxx74iLObW9HNFoehsSuB5jgBmrrbUCaKYwkcNumvUiF9yTTRNVnTUbLT8eWHWqGMQoKQvZoXDPBT6oEu5chPFR9ZMr1iIfoFI52_b_PVIMQWdXCs2tf3ud9)_** , and I'm angry and astonished. **He 's talking to Democrats about needing _"_****bodyguards for everybody and civil war conditions**** _"_****after they disqualify President Trump from holding office.** **_[This might be the most important email I've ever sent you, and everyone who receives this email needs to read exactly what Raskins said](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=60a9065981054031988260721512e78c&_e=y1iL6GedETH6raeYNgsTjmnFI1T97LR3uj7Eo3X9CN4yknXY8E_XDLbgBBsQh4bkz37BBr2w6n1NbTypqg2tvK8QMpdUmLC1HLnRDmGGofK8T6XFF3pxfdaqlnOxrDctxWgPEVnh_6_MGL9MTKpSsnI1SRu4xWOK78Oci4DvnFKNTybfOjW-9437mYGPMwsdAWMkWamgwOXDIRsw25p4FvWVKfYSq92ZajknLmC-XU6LadVukN46vAs2MxxE5rMjMJRFWio6j4BnsDrbxKznXgXl0btoD-Tj-8fSd5589lhwXFx39g8puLzx4Nmn1AR0)_.** I've known for a long time that Raskins has Trump Derangement Syndrome, but I never thought he'd plot to destroy our Republic because of it. There is no question we are in one of America's darkest hours and that evil surrounds us. It can be demoralizing at times, _but we cannot lose sight of why we fight_. **For our families, our faith, and the last bastion of freedom in the world; the United States of America.** I refuse to cower in fear and I will not waver in my fight to save the country I love. **_[I hope you're ready to join us, there's no more time to sit on the sidelines](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=60a9065981054031988260721512e78c&_e=y1iL6GedETH6raeYNgsTjmnFI1T97LR3uj7Eo3X9CN4yknXY8E_XDLbgBBsQh4bkz37BBr2w6n1NbTypqg2tvK8QMpdUmLC1HLnRDmGGofK8T6XFF3pxfdaqlnOxrDctxWgPEVnh_6_MGL9MTKpSsnI1SRu4xWOK78Oci4DvnFIvGnUbjzl4zfNjTizm00KqwKTCbFE9hg64SxGpfoesLL7HdYmAcp_g7xPwHiVZ2BaEy_Sess4cmb9dBx5dEOXWUHvME1y3UHWFFpRrKX5q3mhsRhPR8x7bfD_aty8wMx7NEo0cpPypRf8I67hjpGTZ)_.**

With so many feeling the effects of these decisions, there is growing concern about the risks they pose to our rights and protections, sparking debates about whether or not the Supreme Court should have term limits.

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Tammy Baldwin is running for re-election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support her. I hope you’ll read the message below from her, and [**consider splitting a donation between Tammy's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-baldwin.7r5nHM&refcode=em240810-1-30&t=1&akid=5848%2E6688874%2EqNwicb)

from wife of Harris' VP pick makes many Americans think twice

since it was revealed that Tim Walz would be the VP pick for
Harris, Americans have been looking into the family's past. And
people are very concerned by what they have seen.

And now, a shocking discovery
from the wife of Harris' VP pick has made millions of Americans
shudder.
➞ Continue Reading

Nancy Pelosi confesses to
an incredibly evil act that is dropping jaws

Pelosi is starting to
air out everyone's dirty laundry. She has lost the gavel, and
she's taking people with her.
➞ Continue Reading

Biden comes out of hiding
to prove he's completely insane

The president has
gone out of the public eye. The Democrats want nothing more than
to put him away for good.
➞ Continue Reading

Kamala Harris is utterly
humiliated for one brain dead statement

Harris is not the
sharpest tool in the shed. Now it's obvious.
➞ Continue Reading

When President Biden recently announced his proposal for Supreme Court reform, it was a big win for our movement.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240810-4191-footer&t=1&akid=4191%2E420207%2EXvxlJ1)
Peter,
Pramila has been working to bring transparency and accountability to the Supreme Court for some time now.
So when President Biden recently announced his proposal for Supreme Court reform, it was a big win for our movement — because his ideas mirror the progressive legislation Pramila and others have been working on.
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240810.4m5Lge&refcode=em20240810-4191&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4191%2E420207%2EXvxlJ1)
**[Pitch in to support our movement! ➡️](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240810.4m5Lge&refcode=em20240810-4191&t=3&akid=4191%2E420207%2EXvxlJ1)**
Most Americans don’t know that the Supreme Court is the _only_ court in the land that does not hold its members accountable to an enforceable code of ethics.
And we can see very clearly what that’s led to: a situation where sitting Supreme Court Justices can accept thousands in “gifts” _**(aka BRIBES)**_ from billionaires with business before the Court. And then they feel like nothing will happen if they “forget” to report them on their financial disclosures!
But the president’s proposal isn’t just about a code of ethics. It also includes **18 year term limits** for each justice, ensuring each president would be able to appoint a justice every 2 years, and a **constitutional amendment** to overturn the Court’s ridiculous decision that presidents are somehow above the law.
This is something three quarters of Americans agree on, including a majority of Republicans and a supermajority of independents. But Mike Johnson has already made it clear his party will oppose this legislation in the House, meaning we’ll need to flip the chamber back to blue if we want to get it passed.
[**So Peter, if you’re ready to flip the House and make real progress on Supreme Court reform and the rest of our progressive agenda, will you pitch in $3 to support Pramila’s campaign today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240810.4m5Lge&refcode=em20240810-4191&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4191%2E420207%2EXvxlJ1)
