name: VoteVets HQ
subject: VoteVets is calling BS on JD Vance
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
A Veteran should know better than to attack another Veteran’s service, and it’s disappointing to see him stoop this low. We commend JD for his service in the Marines, even if it didn’t impart the respect for democracy and the Constitution we would hope for.
#
Peter —
Trump and Vance must be pretty scared of Tim Walz. In less than 24 hours, they are already degrading his 24 years of service in the National Guard.
Now, we don’t expect much out of Trump... “Bone spur deferment” Trump.
“My sex life was ‘my personal Vietnam’” Trump.
“I like people who weren’t captured” Trump. “Suckers” and “Losers” Trump.
But a guy like JD Vance, a Veteran himself, should know better than to attack another Veteran’s service, and it’s infuriating to see him stoop this low. We commend JD for his service in the Marines, even if it didn’t impart the respect for democracy, the Constitution, and his fellow Veterans that we would hope for.
But if they’re attacking Tim Walz after serving honorably for more than two decades, they’re attacking every Veteran’s service. And if they’re going to stoop that low, we’re going to push back. You can be damn sure it won’t go unanswered.
JD Vance is LYING, by saying Tim Walz retired to avoid a deployment to Iraq. The TRUTH is that Tim submitted his retirement request to the Guard months prior to the notification of their deployment. His request was approved. He retired as his battalion’s highest ranking enlisted man after 24 years of service, and his unit deployed fully staffed.
JD Vance is also lying by saying Tim is guilty of Stolen Valor over the last rank he attained — a serious charge. The TRUTH is that the Minnesota National Guard has formally emphasized in public statements that Tim Walz can be referred to as having been a Command Sergeant Major. That is the rank under which he served.
This kind of low-down, drag-out politics is par for the course for Trump and Vance. But the truth is, this isn’t something most organizations understand well enough to fight back against. Trump and Vance think they can lie about Tim’s service and get away with it. It’s up to VoteVets and our supporters to correct the record early and often, to make sure this BS from the MAGA-right doesn’t stick.

Do you remember the first time you voted?
Maybe it was in a presidential election, or maybe you were eager to elect someone in your community. Voting should be an empowering experience, and we hope that’s what you encountered.
But maybe you faced issues in casting your vote. Maybe you found that your registration was challenged, or your polling place was closed with no warning. The wait to vote might have taken hours, or you were eventually turned away without being able to vote.
It’s frustrating to have to navigate barriers to voting, and that’s why we fight to protect access to the ballot box.

These values guide me in my work every single day as a U.S. Senator — and I know they guide my friend Tim Walz too. Knowing that Minnesota values are on the ballot this November is reason enough for me to be fired up about this election. **But knowing that the alternative to the Harris-Walz ticket — Donald Trump and JD Vance — represent _everything Minnesota values are not,_ puts an even bigger fire in my belly to get to work.** While Vice President Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are committed to serving others and lifting others up, Trump and Vance tear us apart and throw vicious attacks at anyone who disagrees with them. Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me.
I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio.
Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our "leaders" in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind.
**_Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream._**
When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn't know what I was getting into.
But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=3f6552e8cf1641d781bf9cfcca019984&_e=QMT74GlO1VnuFyM9MT780NgDoHZjOoZ6CwNmLFKWr8kzW7lNEsRD0qkOYDUkqR9291lnDikTYnfaB93N-36TuyrSnkHU9SNetp-VULzyuIuVfnWhiYNULONvhgquxPRCAxMmyRGGGpOx0GTtvRIvv8xquq0MBGhVkzO3cle3D6sejsVtdRtwoa4efPXNMrpjLj18xpsjFIcEpBnOUK-8wuclEpBsApxLAwla7dvjorvwxj7bfSEp4XTrR73I4PNw6_2cSBt4FbC7VuNgO09sD-w4ajag93weVf3FfI8e-j1sej5LwFEcwWZYjG0KZdd58aI4rk4CagiVCfA1Jqz5aNau_y2Xd9HXHhp9SX-obFg%3D)

I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I'm proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn't like you'd see in the movies.
My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation.
We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility.

clean_body: I want to tell you what being a veteran means to me. From the yellow footprints at recruit training to the desert of Iraq, I hope this message finds you well. | | | | | Friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about my path to becoming a United States Marine, and what being a veteran means to me. I grew up in the small town of Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once an industrial powerhouse, but thanks to the unfair trade deals signed by our "leaders" in DC, the people of Middletown were left behind. Like most of the enlisted Marines I served with, I joined the military to serve my country. It was also a way for a kid from a poor family to achieve the American Dream. When I got off the bus and stepped on the yellow footprints at Marine Corps Recruit Training, I honestly didn't know what I was getting into. But when my Drill Instructor handed me my Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and I earned the title of United States Marine, it was one of the proudest moments of my life. Compared to others I served with, I think my time in the Corps was rather unremarkable. I deployed to Iraq, did my duty, and I'm proud of my service. But I was lucky. There were some scary moments, but it wasn't like you'd see in the movies. My time in the Corps was nothing compared to the sacrifices made by generations of Marines that came before me - and a lot in my own generation. We ask so much of our men and women deployed around the globe. And they do it with honor and humility. That 's what keeps me going every single day. Our veterans and servicemen, young and old, need to know we have their backs. President Trump was the best Commander-in-Chief of my lifetime, and if we're going to get him back in the White House, it will all come down to your support. My time as a Marine taught me that every man has to do his part. I won't run from the biggest fights we face as a nation. If you give me this opportunity, you have my word that President Trump & I will fight tooth and nail to put you and your family FIRST. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Friend, Behind closed doors, weapons contractors and AI companies are working together to build fully autonomous weapons that can select and fire upon targets without any human control. We’re seeing the devastating impact that AI systems can have in Gaza, where the extensive damage to civilians and most buildings is connected to multiple AI-based systems such as “Habsora,” “Lavender,” and “Where’s Daddy?” to target and kill entire Palestinian families and neighborhoods at record speeds.1 Humans still operate these systems, but the scale of destruction is unprecedented, with one former Israeli official saying these tools enable a “mass assassination factory.” In response to a report about the Israeli military’s AI weapons systems, **UN Secretary General António Guterres** said: _“No part of life and death decisions which impact entire families should be delegated to the cold calculation of algorithms.”_ In addition to a permanent ceasefire and an arms embargo, anti-war activists are urging President Biden to ban these AI weapons systems. | Peter,

Throughout my career, I have used everything I learned from growing up in New Hampshire to stand up to bullies because I believe deep in my bones that no person or corporation is above the law.

When President Joe Biden was elected, I took my fight to the Justice Department, where I served as Deputy Assistant Attorney General. During my tenure, I stood up to corporate monopolies head-on, going after real estate companies that colluded to raise rent prices and big healthcare companies making everyday life harder for Granite Staters.

Corporate monopolies have exploited the American people for far too long. Their unchecked power has stifled competition, raised prices, and undermined the livelihoods of countless families. It’s time for change!

As the only candidate in this race who has never taken any corporate PAC money, your support ensures that we remain focused on the real issues that matter to Granite Staters and build a campaign powered by the people, for the people.

During my tenure, I stood up to corporate monopolies head-on, going after real estate companies that colluded to raise rent prices and big healthcare companies making everyday life harder for Granite Staters. Corporate monopolies have exploited the American people for far too long. Their unchecked power has stifled competition, raised prices, and undermined the livelihoods of countless families. It’s time for change! As the only candidate in this race who has never taken any corporate PAC money, your support ensures that we remain focused on the real issues that matter to Granite Staters and build a campaign powered by the people, for the people. I am running for Congress to continue this vital work and hold corporate monopolies accountable on day one – but I need your help. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = Together, Maggie * | | = Paid for by Maggie for Congress Maggie for Congress 131 Daniel Webster Hwy #949 Nashua, NH 03060 United States | | | ---|---|--- = =

body:
Ballot Access hangs in the balance in 5 states

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ba_8_10_donors_lt_300&n=1)
---
Peter, Jill’s ballot access situation is dire in the remaining 5 states. We need to raise tens of thousands of dollars in the next few weeks or millions of voters in Minnesota, Delaware, Alabama, Virginia, and Rhode Island will not have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency candidate alternative in November. The deadline for collecting signatures in these states is coming up fast. In Minnesota and Delaware, we have until August 20th. In Alabama and Virginia, the deadline is August 23rd, and Rhode Island’s deadline is September 6th. We are running out of time to ensure Jill gets on the ballot in these last few states. We know we have been sending a lot of emails asking for donations, but it’s no exaggeration to say that if we don’t raise a significant amount of money in the next few days, Jill will lose ballot access in Minnesota, Delaware, Alabama, Virginia, and Rhode Island. **The good news is that if everyone who gets this email donates at least $2.40, we will raise enough money to get Jill on the ballot in all of these states. But we need everyone to pitch in now.** **[Peter, we need supporters like you to give as much as you can today. The reality is, this race is going to be really, really close. Listen, I’ve won tough races before, and I’ve defeated Lori Chavez-DeRemer twice. But my opponent is supported by deep-pocketed Republicans who are dumping millions into this race.
This is going to be one of the closest House races in the entire country, and we have to be ready to fight back against millions in outside spending if we're going to win.

My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m the Democrats #1 target.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQbyhN-FI3t-01e93lck50n2tbbRm_G7JhSiK5_VBXTnQYeZTZiOiEnryWZl0ryllcX1y1gGkMmJ7EyEb_9c1Z-Kgu8YUKNOZwusLIDbShXOh1x5CnXHHVfkE0l8pN2PANRIOK2ZlxlDOq5kpqdEyClw%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQSBl2ta8TGKjlen4lRuuO6s_Kpx_AYrtHS4Vba7vgxRQd-oH_vu84PCk0kriYgpUJleaN_816c2NMWhWBR0wjpe0Do4s70cV-89JmgXTVu1X41fzXjM_qxbtHRuZd6JgAMqnD-T30ZK8nDKeAXla-Rg%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQw730W0_A0Vix2513s8f88jmSaJRdKT7ZU9tMdFuCAz-_PFLKsrnPKwJDWwJtnWz6wWAdQHNI4jGw_fGPLFJswPLFj42gkole1HBV4M9fNdMuX08-W_x6qlxhdWtLglrOdm_BS5enVPsG426vORvZHw%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQun4i_TRDCk7ehzgIswfCYP1MFwkutL6MSwVUDv7VAOPMp4XkQ7mGkoeyaSQOwZHj4YzFSeyNlxz9q_faxIZbol8gC5pzCkCdI81SpD1xcKNJ4ba00ErNXEoXbmPNNGfkIb5IzSLfaqNMpNEY7dsFog%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQZlBxWkTDAuJqIFWuUWB0ruXTG5Uf5p5b0A5W0l9WsmVB7r1LhnZBmHupZlrxQpRhPgYUH1lbaxBic_NiVkDUc0XeXW9gZ9BVrpEKlCSabvBbfoofXsiOw9LbC84BmaxJPBYdt1vqvqBRHPqozaNNdg%3D%3D)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQWuGV870CZaPT4qg8nh2NKQjcpShs8yFS_xY3QbAGSZAY80C6CpXFZEVJPzGSdMNQ1y6KONARz690YSzEZkMzIncqpocHPG1WHcVsvlnDely0QfbPFXBDRA2FV8G64f-G0tiWieiN2t7FM7fL1bQZvQ%3D%3D)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQ78mQanOKLTMxu2h1Loam7eP--bmksN9IHKFzRCi6KrID1PP9Y1xwcSZN-biCbrKmM0qexqLAFsk8uaVBolo8qxgtlTTwGkjFGJ7HeUkJyTo0yahkgfC9t7SQ6a8dEjKpGUcMof9qqRMLW_LrD6UTIg%3D%3D)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=f6f823da4b574bbc847bf43304bbdae4&_e=K-6GYrdheBtQINnLR5NoyjG39xMSxg5WbiF9qYw2Nioqkm-r_HkJ3hCohhJFwHLMG1w3UGwLJsZeC-jVB-bn-Y1l2C1_vU4EfQT0nS5kTjSkh-9P4KHuLMWTdfizoo0bBxXnYADXRhyR_UOGKuv_cp9mP5Xulb5GrgxslD3mv6PVXCH6sYClkYkQ9joTPa_vypnjzjQgf5gV7k8tIB_7_LBT23i_HB4Il-YWhPY20AUP1C6gavMYjIHQPcO-LYqQxbZJ08l3V1NVh6GnUcK2rqiJBDAuWPdcwaiXvQEh71stMELCOk8GqyC_bcqdWxvegY-AY-Z17zhKpPhmq7q9Y2KTwQr_CSAq53o6h9RJX30HLi9nfvuWD9QObcC1ahKzZymWyJgnxwTf2dz8s9yCFQ%3D%3D "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

---

Walz and his record. We also hope that if you’re not already on board, you’ll join the fight after reading this email, and get ready to support this new presidential ticket with all you’ve got. [You can save this link for later, and make a split donation if and when you’re ready.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9Q9r-sFzeYyKXinZvA_209pwVweTzJ8ojBBlU0RrOxySL1xj6febB7ADsOSYSfs5QtE9n7HLZ8qf5MV3C4HZN-3sVeFuZQEhTAHechfCFNPQaW5WfTDHrQWC3rq3QE-z1TWHBZJTzeUdvxAvkwK18cCqg5lQKye4DqIQTqHqEj0Y4JlXmsy_vnvgHONaoy48QlpuDFzK6nOA11tVHwGhG9-AHvzbMhS3NAvRBRMU7X1ao4N8vpjcHsj5BJX27cS-OcZbOCd6_46xgGv3HAe4gh5vD5hafyJ8G1siBpDYDylM/48s/U4pigF8cQpWHSileIPSmgQ/h0/h001.FkSeACjOSiQRpdiJckx8xit3i3ghV9V_WLZBnEmIoII) But if you’re still not sold, keep reading! For starters, **he’s good for workers.** As Governor of Minnesota, he signed one of the most pro-worker pieces of legislation that the state has ever seen. It included paid family and medical leave, mandated paid sick days, strengthened teachers’ unions, and cracked down on union busting. **He’s good on education.** Walz is a former high school football coach and social studies teacher — and upon being elected Governor, signed a bill that provided free school breakfast and lunch for kids, and increased spending for public schools by $2.3 billion. **He’s good on housing.** Last year, he signed a historic $1 billion housing investment into law, which included down payment assistance programs, rental assistance programs, and HUGE investments in homelessness prevention. **He’s good on health care.** After _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, Walz signed a statewide bill that guaranteed the right of all Minnesotans to make their own autonomous choices about abortion, contraception, and fertility treatments. He also signed bills to ban conversion therapy; shield those seeking and providing gender-affirming care; and legally protect patients and providers if they receive care in Minnesota after traveling from a state where it’s banned. **He’s good on climate.** As governor, he passed a law requiring Minnesota to move to 100% clean energy by 2040, implemented additional tax rebates for electric vehicles, and invested more in vehicle charging stations. **And he did all this with a NARROW legislative majority. At a time when most politicians shy away from bold ideas that help working families, Tim Walz showed up.** This doesn't mean we’ll never disagree with Tim Walz or Vice President Harris, or that we'll never have contrasting views on policy. **But we’re ready to do everything we can to elect them over the next 87 days, and we hope you’ll join us.** [**Can you split a contribution between Harris/Walz and the WFP General Election Fund today? clean_body: We wanted to take a minute to cut through some of the noise. | | | Hey Peter, We wanted to take a minute to cut through some of the noise and chatter of this week and break down a few of the reasons why we are excited about Gov. Walz and his record. We also hope that if you’re not already on board, you’ll join the fight after reading this email, and get ready to support this new presidential ticket with all you’ve got. But if you’re still not sold, keep reading! For starters, he’s good for workers. As Governor of Minnesota, he signed one of the most pro-worker pieces of legislation that the state has ever seen. It included paid family and medical leave, mandated paid sick days, strengthened teachers’ unions, and cracked down on union busting. He’s good on education. Walz is a former high school football coach and social studies teacher — and upon being elected Governor, signed a bill that provided free school breakfast and lunch for kids, and increased spending for public schools by $2.3 billion. He’s good on housing. Last year, he signed a historic $1 billion housing investment into law, which included down payment assistance programs, rental assistance programs, and HUGE investments in homelessness prevention. He’s good on health care. After Roe v. Wade was overturned, Walz signed a statewide bill that guaranteed the right of all Minnesotans to make their own autonomous choices about abortion, contraception, and fertility treatments. He also signed bills to ban conversion therapy; shield those seeking and providing gender-affirming care; and legally protect patients and providers if they receive care in Minnesota after traveling from a state where it’s banned. He’s good on climate. As governor, he passed a law requiring Minnesota to move to 100% clean energy by 2040, implemented additional tax rebates for electric vehicles, and invested more in vehicle charging stations. And he did all this with a NARROW legislative majority. At a time when most politicians shy away from bold ideas that help working families, Tim Walz showed up. This doesn't mean we’ll never disagree with Tim Walz or Vice President Harris, or that we'll never have contrasting views on policy. But we’re ready to do everything we can to elect them over the next 87 days, and we hope you’ll join us. These next few weeks are so, so critical, Peter. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have a ton of momentum. And it’s on all of us to double down while Trump and his MAGA pals are still on their heels. Between now and November, WFP and our biggest allies plan to knock on over five million doors across key swing states. We want to reach voters everywhere — on the streets, at the doorstep, and over the phone lines. But a nationwide plan like that takes time and resources. And with just 87 days until the election, there’s not a moment to lose. Thank you, thank you, thank you! Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. Peter,
I am writing to you today with a heavy heart. On Tuesday, AIPAC megadonors succeeded in buying this seat.
The same forces who targeted Jamaal Bowman for his unwavering commitment to human rights poured $15 million into my opponent’s campaign. It’s obvious that right-wing megadonors fear unbought, unbossed, democratically elected Black candidates like Jamaal and myself. They are threatened by our fight for racial and economic justice, Medicare for All, climate action, and a permanent ceasefire in Gaza. They don’t like the real, progressive changes we bring to the communities we love.
Jamaal’s defeat and my own are stark reminders of the immense power of far-right super PACs like AIPAC and their billionaire backers.
But let me make one thing clear: they may have taken away my position as Congresswoman, but they just pulled the strings off. We've faced challenges before, and we've always risen stronger, more united, and more determined. Our fight for justice, equity, and dignity for all does not end here. We are still here, and we are still standing. Y’all, this is a movement, not a moment.
And I promise, I will stop at nothing to make sure these GOP megadonors don’t oust another one of my progressive colleagues. I am determined to continue doing my all to reject their extremist agenda and efforts.
Our fight for justice and freedom continues, and I am more determined than ever to make a difference. One of the causes closest to my heart is justice for Mike Brown.
His family — my dear friends — deserve justice. They deserve a country rooted in true racial, social, economic, and environmental justice. They deserve us pursuing the policies that would have kept their son alive.
As someone who was on the front lines with the Brown family during the national movement, I witnessed the pain and struggle of our community firsthand. For over 400 days, I stood with Michael Brown Jr.'s family and took their fight to Congress, demanding systemic change. It's clearly up to us to bring justice for Mike Brown—and end police brutality. We must continue our work by supporting the Michael Brown Sr. Chosen For Change Organization [https://www.chosenforchange.org] , a group dedicated to justice, advocacy, and systemic change.
As we mark the 10-year anniversary of Mike Brown’s death, please consider donating to Chosen For Change to help us continue the fight for justice and make a meaningful impact in our community. Peter, thank you for standing with me and for your unwavering support. Truly. I could not have made it this far without you. I am more than grateful for every dollar, every phone call, and every email forwarded than you will ever know... Thank you.
And to all the little girls who see themselves in me, we did not fail. You keep rising, you keep going after what you are seeking, hold fast to who you are, because this is only the beginning.
In solidarity forever,
Cori Bush

In some regions, entire communities have yet to receive a single verse of scripture, while others face a severe shortage of Bibles.

I'm reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the transformative power of the gospel.

Our commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that the gospel reaches every corner of the world.

When you give today, you will:
* Not only pass a Bible along but potentially change lives eternally.
* Help support over 3,500 IMB missionaries on the ground, teaching the Bible and bringing hope to spiritually lost communities.
* Answer God's call to share His Word with those who have yet to hear it.

You can click on the secure link below to make a donation of any amount and bring the transformative power of the gospel to those who need it the most.

Let me explain why this is such a pivotal moment.
#
**We’ve only got one month left ahead of us until the September 10 primary.**
[**If that’s all you need to hear, can you rush a $5 donation to my campaign now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240810-1?refcode=em20240810-1-980&amount=5&refcode2=980_21716_YBr1bW&akid=980%2E21716%2EYBr1bW)
Let me explain why the upcoming Democratic primary is such a pivotal moment: This is an important milestone for our campaign to show the strength of our movement. The primary is our opportunity to prove that _we have what it takes_ to win big in November.
We’ve spent months building a campaign we can all be proud of, one centered around the idea that even in a divided Congress, we can make progress and achieve results just like we’ve done in Delaware. We’re running a campaign that believes we CAN expand access to health care and reproductive rights, advocate for workers and families instead of the big-money special interests, and keep our communities safe from gun violence.
I’m so proud to report that we have received a LONG list of major endorsements from elected officials like Congresswoman Blunt Rochester and Senator Carper to organizations like the AFL-CIO and Planned Parenthood. And even better, thousands of you have contributed to this campaign or signed up to volunteer your time.
**This campaign has what it takes to go the distance, but first we’re facing a major test.**
Now, _we’ve got less than a month until the primary election_ — and early voting will begin even sooner, at the end of August! We don’t have any time to waste if we’re going to win.
I need your support now more than ever. That’s why I’m reaching out to you with a personal request: [**Can you chip in $5 to help me win one month from today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240810-1?refcode=em20240810-1-980&amount=5&refcode2=980_21716_YBr1bW&akid=980%2E21716%2EYBr1bW)

Friends ,
Today, we’re taking a powerful stand against the deeply rooted culture of abuse and enablers within the ULTRA-MAGA world.
At our Women’s Empowerment Luncheon earlier today, we didn’t just talk about change – we are making it happen.
One of our featured speakers today was a courageous Ohio State survivor who directly experienced the consequences of Jim Jordan’s failure to act.
For those who don't know, Jim Jordan was accused of turning a blind eye to the sexual abuse of student-athletes by Dr. Richard Strauss during his time as Assistant Wrestling Coach at Ohio State University.
Multiple former wrestlers have claimed they informed Jordan about the abuse, but he did nothing to stop it.
Jordan’s record as an enabler of abusers is a stark reminder of what’s at stake in this election.
While he callously ignored the suffering of those he was supposed to protect, we are rallying together to ensure that no one in power can ignore the voices of victims ever again.
I want to bring this type of leadership and protection to Washington – a voice for those who have been silenced, a champion for justice, and a defender of our values. Let’s elect a leader who stands up for what's right. Contribute today and help us send a real advocate to Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240810_abusers_enablers_link1]
Today’s event was more than just a gathering; it’s a movement to dismantle the toxic culture that has plagued our society and politics for far too long.
We’re exposing the abuse, holding those responsible accountable, and empowering women to step up and lead.
As part of my commitment to ending this culture of abuse, I am working with lawmakers in D.C. to get my bill, the Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act , introduced and passed.
This bill will help protect students and athletes from abuses that have been ignored for far too long.
We’ll be sharing highlights from today’s event soon, but the fight doesn’t stop here.
We need your support to keep this momentum going. Together, we can ensure that the culture of abuse and enabling is eradicated from our government for good. Contribute now and be a part of this fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240810_abusers_enablers_link2]

subject: Arizona has never elected a Native American to Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

Hi Peter,
Across the US, our Native American communities have historically suffered at the hands of our federal government — forced from their ancestral homelands in a brutal genocide that stains our nation to this day. Here on Navajo Nation, our people’s roots run deep: we are a rare example of a tribe that retains access to our ancestral lands. Despite the history of our government’s oppression towards America’s native peoples, we have consistently demonstrated patriotism of the highest order: serving in our armed forces at a disproportionately high rate, stewarding some of our nation’s most beautiful landscapes, and so much more.
I’m humbled to have won the Democratic nomination for Arizona’s 2nd Congressional District, and it would be the honor of my lifetime to serve as our state’s first-ever Native American member of Congress. The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue! —Tim
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
My name is Leslie Mehta.
I’m writing from the campaign trail here in Virginia’s 1st, where I’m working day in and day out to take back the Democratic majority in the House.
The House isn’t the only thing up for grabs in November, though — Senator Tim Kaine is running for re-election, and we’re going to need your help to hold our Democratic majority in the Senate.
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie] I’ll be upfront: I’m going to ask for your support today because keeping up our momentum is critical if we want Virginia to stay on the path to progress. If you’re on board and ready to give our Commonwealth the representation it deserves, consider splitting a donation between Senator Tim Kaine and my campaign today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
DONATE TODAY >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
Today, I want to let you know a little bit about me, and why I’m in this race.
I was born and raised in a small town in North Carolina, with 800 residents and zero traffic lights. My parents, a corrections officer and a social worker, instilled in me early on the importance of service and giving back where you can — something that I’ve held onto ever since.
It’s a value I held throughout my undergraduate and law school career, and that I lived every day when I became a civil rights lawyer and fought tooth and nail to advocate for the civil rights and liberties of all Virginians.
I did the same when I was appointed by both Governors Ralph Northam and Glenn Youngkin to work under their administrations. And it’s the same reason I’m running for Congress — to give the people of VA-01 the leadership they deserve.
Virginia’s future is on the ballot this November. That’s why I’m partnering with Tim Kaine — someone who knows a thing or two about real service to all Virginians.
It’s only with your help that we can ensure Virginia’s future is in the hands of pro-choice, pro-democracy Democrats. In this critical moment, will you split a contribution of $20 or more between Tim Kaine’s campaign for Senate and my campaign for Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
DONATE TODAY >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-leslie]
Sincerely,
Leslie Mehta

name: Devin
subject: [Video] Our campaign is ending. And beginning.
body:
I have a promise for you as our campaign ends. | | | | | |
---
| You’re receiving this email because of your past support for Democratic campaigns and causes. If you do not wish to hear about our progressive platform, you can [unsubscribe](https://devinhermanson.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=183f0f0d7b868d7a3cf101385&id=33f2e7f213&e=10cc7d1928).
---
| Hey Peter,
Just a note of thanks and my promise to you about the future.
About 10,000 people cast their vote for this first-time candidate. **I could not be more honored, and I promise I'm not done fighting!**
The day after the election, I got a clear sign of why it’s so important for all of us to stay involved. **I got an email from Representative Larsen**.
---
[](https://devinhermanson.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=183f0f0d7b868d7a3cf101385&id=bf0cd7e8cf&e=10cc7d1928)
| It was a pretty standard letter about his victory, but **once again, Larsen failed to mention the historic threat our democracy faces!**
Larsen’s email left me perplexed, and I told him so. I’ve received no reply from his campaign, but that’s where you come in.
**My promise to you is that I'm not going anywhere**. I'll be fighting for democracy, holding Rep Larsen accountable and ask that you commit to doing the same. **There are at least 10,000 of us! That’s a loud, powerful voice that won’t be ignored.**
And we can't settle for a choice between dictatorship and the status quo. We're going to demand more. **We need Larsen and the rest of Congress to act with urgency and boldness.**
I hope you'll continue with me on this journey and **help give President Kamala Harris a Congress that's ready to make history.**

Thank you for your support and passion for our country.

More soon!
\- Devin and Team Hope

PS, Let me know what you’re most fired up about in this election. What do you think our top priority should be?

---

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a518846881954a3b9c9ddc651b50dfe8&_e=jO4f8fpCyjwbKO6C9wBM9F98mJPAcogaB1bTl-oAoeUzLpqGedcaPP-6T4m1ZfqWvCwv5MpRA8rlxfmwMkC4OyFtITdBCkIxth4e6oB7dEBFOPBcxOOkI5vchlB_3zpY9eLzc7v4gcIBkMGdMzkVnCKqWfgDiZX3DcZvkLsM6V0KbVOqsWI9VKvjmidsrBv3FsYoH94stcpaROohu9qJZ0scER5sPT6VnrP58p8jKONkWf6TBFyz_EV8l31lIj23hFiCrhMs-MVQOCzmSoExtNQXdgYavX3zD9GhmXsURF6GEZ7JksnywGiMy4XTrGX6LnVF4nU7EZdwbemwnZ6Xzd8PeeqFo768iZHe-enpZgPnWwDIz4DUO3qYowTZgvOiYh66rx9jJrXx2k681zcwzu7G7m0v7vRuvyj99h08H9UoQRrY-CS08ZMkJU4b6vMg) [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a518846881954a3b9c9ddc651b50dfe8&_e=jO4f8fpCyjwbKO6C9wBM9F98mJPAcogaB1bTl-oAoeUzLpqGedcaPP-6T4m1ZfqWvCwv5MpRA8rlxfmwMkC4OyFtITdBCkIxth4e6oB7dEBFOPBcxOOkI5vchlB_3zpY9eLzc7v4gcIBkMGdMzkVnCKqWfgDiZX3DcZvkLsM6V0KbVOqsWI9VKvjmidsrBv3FsYoH94stcpaROohu9qJZ0scER5sPT6VnrP58p8jKONkWf6TBFyz_EV8l31lIj23hFiCrhMs-MVQOCzmSoExtBXcC7I_giTXtpjtpGSH05J36BAn6NqmTefGu7BV8TqeK_4Qszm7tc56dJMQmEECA5wgEi5zmBh__VFXljJCLetQlmZqLz-1t4JuminUQBjlY_r9sBQVrujjKpfWa7GgUjlAbJ0I3-TIuLhRA-lx3uzp9lhy-dHau3oo4DKE6E88) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a518846881954a3b9c9ddc651b50dfe8&_e=jO4f8fpCyjwbKO6C9wBM9F98mJPAcogaB1bTl-oAoeUzLpqGedcaPP-6T4m1ZfqWvCwv5MpRA8rlxfmwMkC4OyFtITdBCkIxth4e6oB7dEBFOPBcxOOkI5vchlB_3zpY9eLzc7v4gcIBkMGdMzkVnCKqWfgDiZX3DcZvkLsM6V0KbVOqsWI9VKvjmidsrBv3FsYoH94stcpaROohu9qJZ0scER5sPT6VnrP58p8jKONkWf6TBFyz_EV8l31lIj23hFiCrhMs-MVQOCzmSoExtOeb5_mmVQDoc-sPxO7T1KPm3tDKErnRaQx0rtxHjl7j9Yx3u4hq8Ttkm0KvIwTpjxmBkvsjjyNwAt9-ftzOeRfHKWPMER5rk31wi0anvoSD2fgvtiqfc4x_odAcmZcBEEZ_lqPyzmFptqgTjryfJAxZ3Eclpd7wdAPk2ouZciMZ)

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Robert F. Kennedy Jr. made a promise to you and me.
RFK Jr. is willing to do whatever it takes to build a bridge to both sides. Can Trump and Harris make the same promise to the American people?
Dear Peter,
We can unite this country.
Our mission to achieve unity is not some poll-tested, survey-driven message. **It is at the heart of RFK Jr.’s campaign.**
Why? Because division has paralyzed Congress, so that it is unable to enact commonsense solutions to basic problems. Instead, wealthy corporate interests set the agenda while everyone is distracted by divisive culture war issues.
The hatred between the Democrats and Republicans is tearing the country apart. Yet, most Americans are not hateful at all.
That is why we need an Independent President, willing to build a Unity Government as did President George Washington, to bring the two sides together and pass common sense legislation.

During my time as Speaker of the House, the balance of power made all the difference in advancing a conservative agenda that worked FOR the People. **Imagine what we can achieve if we elect Nella Domenici,_finally_ flip New Mexico red, and take back the Senate.**

Nella is a strong, principled, independent leader who will stand up for our values and work tirelessly to bring common-sense solutions to the Senate. Her commitment to border security, economic growth, and restoring American strength is exactly what New Mexico – and our country – needs right now.

The stakes are high, and the radical left is pouring a ton of resources to hold onto seats like this one in New Mexico. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| Peter,

Ken Calvert has had 16 terms in Congress.

**I am asking for a chance to bring fresh ideas and new perspectives to CA-41.**

But, I pledge to every single person reading this email that for every single second of every single day that your happiness and your security will be my mission.

Because the Republicans and Democrats that I grew up with, taught me that justice means doing right by you and your families.

And I was taught that what makes America great is not that we are perfect or were perfect in the past, it is our collective responsibility to make this union more perfect.

That is why even in our nation’s darkest moments, we have done the right thing and persevered because just enough Americans have stepped up to the plate and done the right thing.

That’s why I’m proud to be an American. That’s why I’m proud of this team we’re building. And that’s why we’re going to win this election.

Kamala Harris. She's tough, fearless, and tenacious. With our democracy at stake and our future on the line, no one is better to prosecute the case against Donald Trump's dark vision and guide our country in a brighter direction than her. Donald Trump? Well, it is not often that I find myself pitying Donald Trump, but that is where I find myself today. He is not prepared for Kamala Harris. name: Jen Kiggans
subject: Seen these pictures before?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems.

| |
---
| | |
My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target.

In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign.

But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFenCGoD3J-uJkqc02rBg2aKEi6HmgIZeGHqECy2RMhG2jvW9UGX38P702ee33fJCcuXUJvPIy2EaE7rKYljM8BrIlPI2Wg3ockMG2zVcsWAHM1ORKs4avFP330M6QpDSco7VtSJsmTyvBxGxlSyQhE7aQ%3D%3D)
---

That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFeneDRQte-IxI_2hsCUcHK-_1EEAEatjd8n_7rC0zm2Sm3rU77jHyr6W0S4w3EmlKxzch3E2M7pSe2Z1RpEqI8G3LSpOFAspbNQmUG30ZU9JW9mMtaQ5ntamDP4iFTpKe453qdTZAspnx_ijDaA-LZfyQ%3D%3D)
---

I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.

After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFenJYCb6vU8iO_hYMiB0E6Qrg1GbH7VMrb9Iq_jsFKwN1RN25-h7_tL6DJ5lKtY4sMwfvHwJVEoCzt3UyvD9m00OSKIyJV5PjykaBLrp-7BijEyNMnmJSIPWVIEb5iMyMdqioaPdE-UBLxms75scj_sUA%3D%3D)
---

Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.

_**So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.**_

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFenq4WNgEc9Zaka7MvyUwEPG1sLKbeURN3LpCzY3mb1VH__vI9A8jYLOJkxtSs42KNL3WB3mR5AiM3oLF-oKX9ZGkpyDso3IOc_qq9MmtqRwETJjQRhJ_MOEDqDaPMJnmssrpaPuod6hp2oG-2boMKTkg%3D%3D)
---

I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.

Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFen-4ibKe9ZRn46rXTuUb5DUDj7R4oUA9MNxDmgqmFhMxzMU22_GQEME3nv54AFmpiXFeQFE5wgSZcc6uPy1OVq59kn9NVI4ZUS4XTz7a88qauBfT0XGHYV3KpjFlb2dBAlQaZ-4E-UyayGUCRCm5INEA%3D%3D)
---

So, I once again decided to stop complaining and _actually do something about it_. So I ran for Congress!

When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFentS0gAwH7Fy24tO0D01CLN304F1OGdE3QvrjBA_V3CmrPW2PnUtTN6eTQ2EeCtoXu2ktn_cWapOMLscN6x0wv5ifZYgUrAFFGaEzJqTO-_yINt2NfmLkpf_7oh521MjnWzR1xrJZ7r8ST8NOEKey1lQ%3D%3D)
---

But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation.

And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. **We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans.** We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started.

---
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFencbZh2f1MifpwTA1XikxDEeVy_FVDC-zh7ZQt_nhMbtr_Mg80_-PNzeY1tKxR86JJp3RwqwQxSLh34JT_fx-YJS2qrRHaEtMso6OzKkLTWv-qLo3DJy5pvLYEnuGJ20p7iSCxL_hrsrWugmpAwBySjA%3D%3D)
---

**But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me.** The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets in 2024, so I'm hoping you will donate today to help our campaign keep going strong.

---
| | [KEEP JEN IN THE FIGHT](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=84f4847139524ff983c995e8b3828fd8&_e=RKMcwF5VfemwH5Zr2ERu6EyG-021DLMsoPNji9JdOTkHCXucrMDFV3CoGSusEtUizOxO1-qMZt2utjSsrGcQqf1Og_VrddcniGlA0vtql4gUwAS5Xq6i3gPT5ZEltlO46RPxYBTKhZNn7clPRo2KimnZDVj_RCc5oh0RChwf1tW1rklNH_gPISrLR8N4xK1e-EQz7ubufDkAYdn-T4FXX4qPCqlBlCiEK5ySrmeUFpTSUv4bz-39GfVz-K-kfFenVxrlmxmzLhEH0Ip4Pd1NgwAVN9TUcMfNafIx-eXBHshyrOoN1hcEdQnuPFK827BvZdmoA04bYkJpbu464IxuZstkx1kgwkk8YuEWUnXr55HAfc2sZCQ--v4_sFB-v1lyiEfc586uNANaiob2KPYpmA%3D%3D "DONATE TO JEN KIGGANS")
---

If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?

I can't stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.

---

clean_body: I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. | | | | | My name is Jen Kiggans, and I want to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm the Democrats #1 target. In 2022, I defeated a liberal Democrat in one of the closest elections in the entire country to help Republicans retake the House of Representatives. They are already spending big bucks to try and defeat me, so I wanted to see if you would be willing to support our campaign. But first, I wanted to tell you a little about myself and what led me to run for Congress in the first place. | That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I'm a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. | I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - "Blossom." I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf. After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve. | Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I'm not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them. So I got off my couch, and I ran for office. | I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities. Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first. | So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. So I ran for Congress! When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that's what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent's campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me. | But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation. And in Congress, we've already been able to make a big impact. We are standing up for veterans, parents, taxpayers, and hard-working Americans. We're making good progress, but the work is just getting started. | But the Democrats and their deep pocket donors are already setting out to defeat me. name: Jill Stein
subject: Israel blew up another school today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
This is why we won’t stop talking about Gaza.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=1)
---
Peter,

For the last six weeks, it’s been increasingly difficult to find mainstream news reporting about Israel’s continued campaign of mass murder against the people of Palestine.

Instead, there has been endless and breathless reporting on the palace intrigue of the presidential race – from Joe Biden’s debate performance to Kamala’s coronation, and everything in between.

Every time you see another cable news host cracking jokes about JD Vance and couches, remember that they’re NOT talking about the fact that Israel is still killing Palestinians in Gaza. Every. Single. Day.

Including today.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=2)
---
Just hours ago, **Israel dropped three 2,000-pound bombs supplied by the Biden-Harris administration on the al-Tabin school in Gaza City** , which was functioning as a shelter for displaced Palestinians – including women, children, and the elderly.

The bombs struck as they were engaged in morning prayers. Many who didn’t die in the initial blast were killed instead by the fire that ripped through the building afterwards.

It’s been four months since the Euro-Med Human Rights Monitor estimated that Israel has dropped over 70,000 tons of bombs on Gaza – nearly FOUR TIMES the total bombs the Luftwaffe dropped on London in WW-II.

**It has not stopped – and it will not stop until**** _we stop giving Israel bombs_****.

** The bombs dropped on the al-Tabin school today were **just three of the more than 14,000 MK-84, 2,000-pound bombs Biden has given Netanyahu** since October 7th.

Since Biden dropped out of the presidential race, many activists within the Democratic party who have relentlessly fought for an end to this genocide have cautiously embraced Harris and her candidacy – believing that President Biden won’t stop capitulating to Israel, but a possible President Harris would.

This is her chance to prove it.

**Harris has the power now to pressure Biden for a full arms embargo against Israel – and a permanent ceasefire. If she expects to earn the support of those who oppose this indiscriminate slaughter, she has to answer those demands.

** The signs are not encouraging, however. The latest shipment of MK-84s was part of ANOTHER $3B military “aid package” for Israel authorized by the Biden-Harris administration only days ago – around the same time **Vice President Harris told pro-Palestine protesters in Detroit,****_“I’m speaking now.”

_** We won’t accept another four years of lip service from Democrats who talk about peace while supplying weapons to war criminals and facilitating the extermination of an entire people.

**[For those committed to ending this genocide, there is only one choice this November. Ours is the ONLY anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-planet, pro-worker campaign with a pathway to the White House. Help me get our campaign in front of every voter who supports a ceasefire and lasting peace with justice.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=4)
---
Israel’s damnable assault on the al-Tabin school is far from an isolated incident. There are at least 200 documented Israeli air strikes against schools over the last 10 months – a number we are certain is undercounted.

Much like the over 600 strikes against hospitals, aid stations, and first responders, Israel’s continued attacks on schools and refugee shelters are flagrant violations of international law.

By supplying the weapons, we are participating in their war crimes, and we will not allow those responsible to turn a blind eye.

Over 100 people died in today’s bombing on this school. After so many months of relentless bombing, the numbers begin to blur together.

But they are not numbers. They are people. They deserved to live, and we owe them justice.

[**We will not allow the beautiful souls of the Palestinian people to be reduced to rubble and statistics. Stand with me and make this campaign as strong as we can so we can deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace on November 5th.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gaza_school_strike&n=5)

As Gaza goes, we all go.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

While serving as the president of the largest synagogue in Nevada, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**

Black Americans have long faced _far too many_ obstacles like: discrimination, lower pay, higher job instability – not to mention the racist voter suppression laws that Texas Republicans like Ted Cruz have championed, which make it harder for certain folks to vote.
**The bottom line is this: It's essential that our government reflects the people it represents.**

Less than 24 hours after declaring he's working hard for a permanent ceasefire, Biden released [another $3.5B in arms to Netanyahu](https://substack.com/redirect/3351b0f3-941f-4d13-aec7-bee8a6a699aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Hours later, Netanyahu bombed 1000 Palestinian civilians taking refuge in the Tabeen School--a designated safe zone--killing at least 100 more innocent people. NBC News [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/1cac2e37-1c72-4a08-a8bb-6629847225ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> An airstrike by the Israel Defense Forces on a school-turned-shelter killed more than 93 people and injured dozens more on Saturday morning, according to[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/4618a67b-c539-4e6f-92bc-21895edc7e36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Gaza's civil defense, in one of the deadliest attacks in the 10-month war. The strikes hit the Tabeen school in Gaza City, including the mosque inside it, as congregants were performing dawn prayers. The IDF said it was targeting a Hamas command center embedded in the school, and that "numerous steps were taken to mitigate the risk of harming civilians," including the use of precise munitions, aerial surveillance and intelligence information.
In short. The US Government arms Israel. The Israeli government bombs and kills civilians. The Israeli military claims they were targeting Hamas. Rinse. Cycle. Repeat. This strategy has to date killed at least 40,000 people directly, and per The Lancet, at least 186,000 people overall. Throughout, the Israeli military refuses to allow independent media to report and has killed at least 165 journalists in Gaza--but expects the world to trust them on their word alone. This is not how a free press works, and this is certainly not how a democracy works.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/20f7f230-9616-43f4-8e8d-ddbfc9727446?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I am at a loss of words to describe my outrage at the loss of innocent life. Imagine a Uvalde massacre funded by US tax dollars occurring multiple times a day. And additionally, instead of cowardly standing by and watching the mass murderer murder innocent children, police keep arming him to murder more and more children. That is what Palestinians are suffering through every single day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f86331ab-f521-4336-bbbb-c447f9443da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Aftermath of Israel's bombing on the Tabeen school, which housed more than 1000 refugees, women, and children.
But what about the hostages? While this point was never a valid excuse to mass murder innocent civilians--in part because Israel also holds thousands of Palestinian hostages and also because the response to war crimes cannot be more war crimes--Hamas is not the blockade on hostage release, Israel is. As I've written before and as is well documented, Hamas agreed to Israel's ceasefire and hostage deal more than three months ago. Back on May 6 Hamas said it [accepted a ceasefire proposal that included release of all hostages](https://substack.com/redirect/488c81d0-9e31-4dae-a1f6-02e2e7e162f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Israel rejected it. Again on June 11, Hamas accepted the binding UN Security Council resolution on ceasefire and release of all hostages--one proposed by Israel itself--and Israel rejected it. As the AP [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/090a3c9b-d943-4a29-94dc-5cf450083bea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Hamas accepts a UN Security Council ceasefire resolution and is ready to negotiate over the details, senior Hamas official Sami Abu Zuhri told Reuters on Tuesday, adding that it was up to Washington to ensure that Israel abides by it. Hamas accepts the UN security council resolution in regard to the ceasefire, withdrawal of Israeli troops and swap of hostages for detainees held by Israel, he said.
And despite the United States [insisting](https://substack.com/redirect/061d1e5c-219a-4faa-8c77-e3f75c0662aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Israel had accepted this resolution (that Israel itself proposed), Israel has to date loudly [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/fbb56083-7cdc-405f-985f-3be77a30ca4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the binding UN Security Council resolution. The Times of Israel [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/fbb56083-7cdc-405f-985f-3be77a30ca4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Ambassador to the United Nations Gilad Erdan informed his US counterpart Linda Thomas-Greenfield on Thursday that Jerusalem opposes the Security Council [resolution](https://substack.com/redirect/a809d837-f39e-4023-82bc-a3d8582160c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) being advanced by Washington that expresses support for the hostage-ceasefire proposal Israel made last week.
It is no wonder that the families of the hostages continue to put the blame squarely on Benjamin Netanyahu's shoulders for failing to secure hostage release, [stating](https://substack.com/redirect/03fdde86-4b79-4788-a9c1-48c5506749eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> In a press statement, the families accused Netanyahu of obstructing potential deals by rejecting offers for hostage releases and adopting a hardened stance in talks with Hamas. They criticized the prime minister for making unilateral decisions without consulting the cabinet and accused him of prioritizing his personal interests over the welfare of the hostages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b78670df-a979-409a-8bf4-54aa682f7084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Why is the outrage from "release the hostages" crowd exclusively aimed at Hamas who has agreed to the UNSC resolution to release the hostages, but not at Netanyahu's incessant refusal to accept his own proposed deal that releases all hostages? And still worse, [Biden has since admitted Netanyahu lied to him about wanting to see the hostages released](https://substack.com/redirect/54b18c57-c0ae-4ec3-931e-8f85a4493745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This makes Biden's decision to continue to arm Netanyahu with billions in missiles that much more indefensible. We are way past the point of words--we need meaningful action to end the siege on Gaza and bring about a lasting peace. Here's what that looks like.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/612944a3-24db-46cb-a84b-9a1157ece719?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We must hold Biden accountable to his words. And in my view, there is no better person to lead that charge than VP Kamala Harris herself. She launched her campaign for President while affirming regarding Palestinians:
> The images of dead children and desperate, hungry people fleeing for safety -- sometimes displaced for the second, third or fourth time -- we cannot look away in the face of these tragedies. We cannot allow ourselves to become numb to the suffering, and I will not be silent.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2406590a-078f-4f7d-ace9-212b61586491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is well past time to speak up with actions, not mere words. So what is VP Harris to do? Clearly put--listen to the will of the American people and uphold justice. VP Harris can take this opportunity to exemplify she does not align with the Biden doctrine on Israel. By upholding justice and ending offensive arms transfers to Netanyahu, she will receive a warm welcome from Democrats, and from disenfranchised voters regardless of party. The facts back this up. For several months, [polling shows that the vast majority of Americans want this siege to end](https://substack.com/redirect/79efad56-7f43-46a7-b8c3-b803123ec53b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* 83% of Democrats demand a permanent and lasting ceasefire, as well as 70% of all Americans.
* 54% of all Americans support suspending all US arms to Israel as long as Israel blocks US humanitarian aid going into Gaza. (Which Israel continues to block).
* 56% of Democrats believe Israel is committing genocide of Palestinians.
* 55% of _all_ Americans under 45 believe Israel is committing genocide of Palestinians.

The data is absolutely clear. On every front, Kamala Harris will increase her chances of becoming President if she moves to uphold justice, demand a permanent ceasefire, and call for an end to arms to Israel. Doing so will necessarily require a departure from the Biden doctrine on Israel. But that's the point. She cannot be seen as a carbon copy of Biden on this issue. Only [34% of Americans approved Biden's policy on Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/726891e5-c45c-4f1a-b714-5489e24093b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a majority of Americans, [55%, disapprove of Israel's actions in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/da6b822d-81cc-40f0-b4aa-db56e4cbdf60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The American people are loudly rejecting this horrific genocide. VP Harris can respond to the American people, take that mandate, and run forward to victory on the tenets of justice and humanity. Doing so will go far beyond not being silent, but will ensure her voice and actions are heard worldwide.
